company_name: Fukuoka Industry, Science and Technology Foundation,Semiconductor Advisory Services
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company provides advisory services and support for semiconductor-related challenges but does not directly supply semiconductor products or equipment.
summary: The Fukuoka Industry, Science and Technology Foundation offers advisory services to companies in Fukuoka Prefecture to address semiconductor-related challenges. They facilitate connections between local companies and organizations, providing technical advice and support for product development and sales expansion.
capabilities: Advisory services for semiconductor industry challenges
Support for product and service development
Facilitation of business matching between companies

regional_presence.Japan: The foundation operates within Fukuoka Prefecture, focusing on local semiconductor industry development.
